title: pane layout
description: A grid of slots seat.sh renders into one herdr tab (SPEC-04 s-labels). Labels and commands take ${MODEL} ${effort} ${ticket} ${seat} ${name} ${state_dir} ${worktree} ${repo}. One slot of kind agent per seat layout; none in a monitors layout. At most one slot of kind test: the seat's own test pane, whose id seat.sh exports as COQ_TEST_PANE (WO-20261011-f896).

command.description: run once in a fresh pane; empty for the agent slot and for a shell

split.description: Opts this slot out of the rows x columns grid: it is split from the slot named by from, not placed by sl_grid_step, and is not counted against grid. Such slots come after every grid slot. ratio is the share the pane being split keeps.
